messages.content: Committed the day-ahead book: discharge 125 MW at hour 00, charge 240 MW at hour 10 and 54.12 MW at hour 11, then discharge 125 MW at hour 23. The check projects $11,060.47 net profit at day-ahead prices, with 125 MWh remaining. I’ll advance and reassess at each watch.

The battery is full at 250 MWh. The latest settled RT price rose to $60.13/MWh in hour 17. I’ll move the planned 125 MWh evening discharge from hour 23 to hour 19 to target the evening price rise, while retaining the 125 MWh end-of-day requirement. Future RT prices remain unknown.
